zh.title: AI 报错时，日志会把什么一起留下？
zh.summary: 我们让 CodeFlowMu 记录一次合成失败：已识别形态的假密钥被遮盖，另一段无固定格式的假敏感信息仍进入动作记录和错误输出文件。

en.title: When an AI tool fails, what else does the log keep?
en.summary: A synthetic failed tool result in CodeFlowMu hid a recognizable fake API key, while an unformatted fake sensitive value remained in the action record and referenced error file.
